title: SM-16.15 - Can external users keep creating surveys by paying a fee
intent: This article answers: SM-16.15 - Can external users keep creating surveys by paying a fee
short_answer: No. The Commission-hosted EUSurvey service is not operated as a commercial paid service. External users cannot maintain or obtain survey creation rights by paying a fee.
important_conditions: External organizations may deploy their own EUSurvey instance under the EUPL licence or use another suitable platform.
